name: The Clove Club
address: Shoreditch Town Hall, 380 Old Street, Shoreditch, London, EC1V 9LT
dinnerNote: Tasting menu, Mon & Thu–Sat (same menu £185 on Tue & Wed; short menu £225 Mon & Thu)
lunchNote: Lunch menu, 3 courses · Wed–Sat (lunch tasting menu £185)

menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: Dinner on Monday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday. On Tuesday and Wednesday the full tasting menu costs £185 at dinner; a vegetarian tasting menu is offered

menus.name: Tuesday and Wednesday tasting menu
menus.note: The full tasting menu at a lower price, Tuesday and Wednesday dinner only

bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable for one to six guests, up to three months ahead on a rolling basis. Card details secure the table; no deposit is taken.
cancellation: Cancelling, rescheduling or cutting numbers with less than 72 hours' notice costs £125 a person for lunch or £155 a person for dinner, charged to the card given when booking.
walkIns: Walk-ins are accepted when there's room, but a table isn't guaranteed. The Bar and Lounge serves a changing menu of small plates, bookable for up to six, and also takes walk-ins.
waitlist: Email reservations@thecloveclub.com with the date, time and party size to hear if a table comes free.
groups: Online bookings are for up to six; menu prices are for parties of up to six. For larger groups and private events, email reservations@thecloveclub.com.
dressCode: No strict dress code; most guests wear smart casual.
children: Children are welcome and eat the same menu, with no children's menu. High chairs on request; there's no room for pushchairs in the dining room.
duration: At least three hours for the tasting menu and two hours for the short tasting menu.
byob: One bottle per two guests, at £75 corkage a bottle plus service.
